outcome: vaginal bleeding in the first trimester
cohort: 644 women in singleton pregnancies (336 IVF/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI); 308 controls) who delivered > 22 weeks of gestation
finding: IVF singleton pregnancies have an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcome, among which prematurity remains the greatest problem.
mod_finding: The study found that women who conceived through IVF had a higher likelihood of elective cesarean section compared to spontaneously conceived pregnancies.
